Q1 the third pair (h_f(b), r(b-1)): anatomised at register level.  The
absence is NOT geometric -- the pair occurs as a consecutive same-token
P-separated run-start pair in every tier and reaches the full stretch
configuration; what is exactly zero is its coincidence with a detector
reading of P.  TP-1/TP-2/TP-3 are derived station arithmetic (the single
unit gap r(b-1) - h_r(b) = 1; the third pair is the unique entry-gap pair
with a shadowed terminal; h_r(b) has no P-preimage), exhaustive B=3..24.
The zero itself is measured and sealed, not derived, and says so.

Q2 RC-3: 922's named measurement is taken.  Both readings of the
discriminator are reported.  Under the reading with content it is neither
necessary nor sufficient; under the reading that is true it is a theorem of
the detector.  RC-3 does not close; the binding component is the P-exact
TAIL.

Restriction gate hard-fails against the pinned 922/891 bytes value for
value before any new number.  Checker is spec'd to refute: own generator
from the kernel's crossing identity validated against the kernel's own
apply_controller_step, own interval-algebra detector, own station-identity
